company_overview: Supabase offers a hosted, open-source Postgres database platform with built-in authentication, instant APIs, real-time data sync, edge functions, file storage, and vector embeddings. It is notable for being open source, SOC2 Type 2 / HIPAA / ISO 27001 certified, and positioned as a primary backend alternative to Firebase, enabling teams to "build in a weekend" and scale to millions of users.
target_audience: Full-stack developers, startups, agencies, and enterprise teams (SaaS, fintech, healthcare, AI builders) needing a secure, fast, scalable Postgres-based backend.

company_overview: Vapi is a platform that enables developers to build, test, and deploy conversational voice AI agents in minutes, handling orchestration, telephony, and integrations. It serves as an API-native enterprise-grade system supporting over 1 billion calls and 1 million+ developers with sub-500ms latency and compliance features like SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI.
target_audience: Developers creating conversational voice AI applications, including enterprises needing to scale voice agents for customer support, lead qualification, and appointment scheduling.
